text:
Sam: Heads-up - I need to push a prod hotfix (v2.4.1 -> v2.4.2) but my YubiKey is dead and Okta won't finish MFA. Can someone with deploy rights run the deploy or grant short-lived access?
Maria: @Sam which change window? We try to avoid out-of-window unless rollback risk low.
Sam: it's a config fix, small DB migrationless change. Change window still open for 20m.
James: infra-bot, what's the deploy bot gating for prod right now? Does it accept service-account tokens?
infra-bot: Deploy-bot: Prod pushes require caller in group release-deployers AND interactive MFA within last 30m. Service accounts are blocked for direct triggers unless proxied by deploy-proxy with JIT token. See https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy.
Katie: Could we do a proxied run via deploy-proxy? We used that for emergency last month. Needs approval from release-leads and ops-oncall.
Maria: @ops-oncall can you approve a one-off proxy-run for @Sam? We need a logged audit trail.
ops-oncall: I'm available. Approve contingent on a canary and manual watch. I will initiate JIT for svcacc deploy-proxy with 15m TTL. :white_check_mark:
Sam: thanks. steps?
Katie: Quick runbook:
```
# Proxy deploy flow
1) ops-oncall creates JIT token: okta-cli jit create --principal=deploy-proxy --ttl=900
2) ops-oncall posts token in ephemeral deploy-bot session
3) deploy-bot run --env=prod --pin=v2.4.2 --canary=10%
4) monitor console -> rollback if error rate >0.5% for 5m
```
Maria: Also add a note to release notes channel after push. Keep verbose logs.
James: minor ask — add a temporary ACL mapping for Sam to 'release-deployers:temp' with expiry in 1 hour? That would simplify future small fixes.
ops-oncall: We prefer proxy flow for auditability rather than permanent temp grants. I'll do proxy now.
infra-bot: Action: created JIT token for deploy-proxy (ttl 900s). Token id jid-83a2. Audit id audit-981.
Katie: starting canary in 1m. @Sam monitor the rollout.
Sam: Canary looks clean at 10%. Proceeding to 100%.
infra-bot: Deploy-bot: rollout complete -> v2.4.2 pinned on prod. Observability: no new errors.
Maria: :tada: thanks team. ops-oncall, please close the JIT and paste audit link.
ops-oncall: JIT closed. Audit: https://audit.internal/audit-981
Sam: added release note: "hotfix v2.4.2 - config fix; no DB changes" in #release-notes
Katie: recommend we add a short retro item: document fallback for MFA device loss. Ticket created ENG-4721.
Maria: agree. tagging security for MFA replacement guidance.
Sam: thanks all. :thumbsup:
